content: Yapeta Tubutubunau
Nowa natunau Semi, Hami ge Yapeta, avaliyau natuliyau ge tubutubuniliyau liwaniliya i ola hiwe. He nub enaa natuliyau hi gewi hi abil.
Yapeta natunau bolau heliya Gomeli, Magog, Madai, Yavan, Tubal, Meseki ge Tilasi.
Gomeli natunau bolau te Askenasi, Lipat ge Togalama.
Yavan natunau bolau te Elaisa, Talsis, ge boda Kit tubuliya ge Lodan tubuliya.
He boda bolo hi miminaa Hoga Mediteleiniya bebenaa ge tavalina ona elal hi neem Yavan natunau o elal. Hi miminek tomaha wali labi ge wali panuwa ona elal, ge anan tomaha ona hi baubaunan.
Hami Tubutubunau
Hami natunau bolau heliya Kus, Itipita, Puti ge Kenani.
Kus natunau bolau te Seeba, Havila, Sabita, Laama ge Sabiteka. Laama natunau bolau te Seba ge Dedan.
Kus tubutubunina etega te Nimlod. Iya haveyan ana toematana gasigasisena, yaka alonau wana boda panuwa hi gewi hi pakokovel.
Yehoba wana labe eliyana iwauka i sibaan. Inoke heiya te kaiwena gamagalau wali ebaaba etega i ola hiwe, “Tau ya i ola te Nimlod, iya houhouwena Yehoba wana labe eliyana iwauka i sibaan.”
Wana abalogugui i tal houwan labi Babiloniya elana, panuwa Babiloni, Elek, Akad ge Kalne elal.
Yaka abwe i na al labi Asiliya inoke panuwa bwabwatal bolo Ninibe, Lehobot-Il, Kala
ge Lesen i ginolil. He Lesen i minaa Ninibe ge panuwa bwabwatana Kala ali hawawala.
Itipita tubutubunau heliya boda Lud, Anam, Lehab, Naptuhi,
Patulusi, Kasiluhi ge Kaptoli. He boda Pilistiya hi neem al boda Kaptoli elal.
Kenani natuna gamaun te Saidoni. Natunau al hi gan, inoke Kenani tubutubunau te boda Hiti,
Yebusi, Amoli, Gegasi,
Hivi, Alki, Sini,
Alvadi, Semali ge Hamati. Un bolo Kenani tubutubunau hi miwaliwali labi tomaha ge tomaha,
yaka labi toto hi miminaa i telipunaa panuwa Saidoni ge i nok Gelal kaiwena ana siga te Gasa, ge i ola al i nok Sodoma, Gomola, Adima ge Seboim kaiweliya ana siga te Lasa.
He Hami natunau ge tubutubunau i ola to. Inoke un bolo o anan tomaha ona hi baubaunan ge hi miminek tomaha wali labi ge wali panuwa ona elal.
Semi Tubutubunau
Semi, iya Yapeta talina bwabwatana, natunau al hi gan. (He iya Ebe alonau tubutubunau tubuliya houhouwena.)
Semi natunau bolau te Elam, Asul, Alpakad, Lud ge Alam.
Alam natunau bolau te Us, Hul, Geta ge Meseki.
Alpakad iya Sela tamana ge Sela iya Ebe tamana.
Ebe natunau bolau eluwa. Etegana alana hi tun Peleg,
kaiwena wana sauga elana gamagalau hi miwaliwali panayawi labena gegewena elal. He Peleg talina alana hi tun Yoktan.
Yoktan natunau te Alimodad, Selep, Hasamavet, Yela,
Hadolam, Usal, Dikila,
Obal, Abimael, Seba,
Opil, Havila ge Yobab. He Yoktan tubutubunau i ola to.
Labena toto hi miminaa i telipunaa Mesa ge i na Sepal, iyoho labi manaoyaoya toto balimana.
He Semi natunau ge tubutubunau i ola to. Inoke un bolo o anan tomaha ona hi baubaunan ge hi miminek tomaha wali labi ge wali panuwa ona elal.
He Nowa natunau ge tubutubunau ali lihu ana siga to, ge tomaha wali labi elana hi miminek. Inoke nub enaa, heliya eliyalil boda tomaha ona hi masalem ge hi miwaliwali panayawi labena gegewena elal.
